reviewer_reasoning: Could mean generating/distributing passwords (FR) or enforcing password security strength (NFR); 'secure' is undefined.
The system is to 'help' planning and execution 'efficiently' without saying which capability or measurable quality is required.
Combines rendering graphics (functionality) with 'smooth' on-screen navigation (performance/usability) without measurable thresholds.
Access through browsers and mobile apps can be viewed as delivery-channel functionality or as portability/platform compatibility; the statement lacks a dominant quality criterion.
Combines dataset submission/management functions, interface usability, and the constraint of no extra software installation in one sentence.
Lists multiple database interaction interfaces, which may be classified as functional access channels or interoperability/interface constraints.
Requires logging errors (functional behavior) as well as permanent storage and sufficient diagnostic detail (auditability and support quality); the dominant classification depends on the taxonomy.
Requires the tool to detect and identify specified HVAC faults using algorithms; this is explicit diagnostic functionality.
Allows authorized users to delete sub-apps and launchers; a specific access-controlled deletion function.
Allows users to create anonymous avatars or aliases, an explicit creation operation.
Requires allowing anonymous avatars or aliases; this is an explicit permitted system behavior.
Requires displaying or supplying usage metrics to administrators, a specified reporting capability.
Allows sponsors to link attendees to sponsorship pages, a defined workflow action.
Lists supported operating-system platforms and versions, a compatibility/portability constraint.
Requires browsing content by author or subject, a concrete search/navigation function.
Specifies the ability to display the customer homepage after login.
Provides a specific navigational action: users can open the Catalogue via sub-navigation icons.
Specifies a per-day quota governing a user's ability to respond to profiles; it is a functional business rule.
Allows selecting a language from supported target-market languages, a user interaction capability.
Enables selecting modes to add image or scene filters and effects; versatility is a benefit of that functionality.
Specifies generation of account-change and asset-schedule logs; auditability is a possible quality motivation.
Requires monitoring processing rates, comparing them to tolerances, and reporting deviations; these are operational functions rather than a direct throughput target.
Specifies role-based authorization behavior, including disallowing students from editing marks.
Requires the ability to interact with the system via CLI; could instead be classified as an interface/platform constraint under another taxonomy.
Calls for transaction safety/security as a quality outcome without specifying an executable mechanism or defined threshold.
Specifies infrastructure and operational staffing to support worldwide service, but 'strong' and 'qualified' are undefined.
Specifies resource-capacity constraints necessary to run Adobe Illustrator functions, not new application behavior.
Mandates particular third-party software versions and codecs, imposing implementation and compatibility constraints rather than a user-facing operation.
Adaptability for people with visual or hearing impairments is an accessibility quality property; 'easily' lacks a measurable criterion.
Requires users to make payments through integrated gateways, which is functionality; 'securely' adds a security quality requirement.
Specifies design and interface constraints: limited graphics and a simple keypad, rather than a discrete operation.
Expresses perceived usability and user experience rather than a specific operation, although 'great' and 'pleasant' are not measurable.
